profile_text.body:
Amazon is a for-profit public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States, with its website at amazon.com. The text harvested from the company's own site for this profile contained no substantive description of its business, so no claims about what it sells or operates can be reported from that source.

No AI products from Amazon are tracked in the record. Four MCP servers are listed in connection with the company. One, ai.sellermate/amazon-ads, is described as letting a user ask an Amazon Ads account anything and act with guardrails, offered as a remote MCP with OAuth and free to connect. Two others, ai.trendsapi/amazon and ai.trendsmcp/amazon, are described as providing Amazon product search volume and best-seller trends, and product search demand over time with growth for any keyword, each requiring a free key. The fourth, app.apiguru/amazon-data, is described as providing live Amazon product, review, search, deal, offer and stock, and seller data across 20 marketplaces.

On litigation, the record lists a case, Haugland v. Anthropic PBC, in the District Court, D. Delaware. It also carries a litigation exposure count of 107 for Washington.
